title: Major Breaking Changes in Discovery Engine v1beta
summary: This update introduces significant breaking changes to the Discovery Engine v1beta API. Numerous parameters are now strictly required, and many properties across various resources have become read-only. Developers must update their integrations to avoid disruptions.
details: Several API methods now require parameters that were previously optional, including `billingAccountLicenseConfig`, `name`, `location`, `parent`, `dataStore`, `resource`, `completionConfig`, `servingConfig`, `siteSearchEngine`, `evaluation`, `groundingConfig`, `identityMappingStore`, and `rankingConfig`. Additionally, a large number of properties across various schemas have been made read-only. This includes fields like `isActionConfigured` in `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1ActionConfig`, `createTime` and `updateTime` in `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1Assistant`, `state` in `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1CmekConfig`, `actionState` and `blockingReasons` in `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1DataConnector`, `billingEstimation` and `defaultSchemaId` in `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1DataStore`, and many more across `Engine`, `LicenseConfig`, `Project`, `ServingConfig`, `Sitemap`, `TargetSite`, `UserLicense`, and `WorkspaceConfig` resources (and their `v1alpha` and `v1beta` counterparts). These changes will require immediate attention and code modifications for existing integrations. New OAuth scopes for `cloud-platform`, `cloud_search.query`, `discoveryengine.assist.readwrite`, `discoveryengine.readwrite`, and `discoveryengine.serving.readwrite` have also been added, expanding permission granularity.
